name: n-D Marching Cubes
aliases: Lazy evaluation isosurfacing for hypercubic cells
definition: An algorithm by Bhaniramka, Wenger, and Crawfis that calculates an n-D hyper-surface (e.g., tetrahedral grid in 4D) for a specific iso-value.
summary: n-D Marching Cubes generates n-D hyper-surfaces using lazy evaluation to reduce computational costs, distinguishing it from high-dimensional triangulation tables.
